h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ajmer

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Ajmer

c: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Ajmer to boarding and day schools, colleges, municipal gardens and residential colonies. The city has long been known as an education centre in Rajasthan, and many campuses here have the open ground an outdoor gym needs. We build our Fun Fitness machines at our factory in Vasai, about 810 km away, and deliver and install them by road.

Ajmer's summers are hot and dry, and the Aravalli hills around the city keep the ground rocky in many places. Hard ground suits grouted installation, where each post is set in concrete. For a school, think about who will use the equipment. Senior students can handle presses and pull-up bars, while staff and visiting parents may prefer walkers and wheels. We can plan both groups into one layout. Morning walkers around Ana Sagar lake show how much people here like to exercise outdoors, and a well-placed gym on a campus gets the same steady use.

richText.heading: An open gym for an Ajmer school or college

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 810 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Are outdoor gym machines safe for school students?
items.a: They are designed for teenagers and adults using their own body weight. Younger children should use them only under supervision, and we suggest a sign with usage instructions beside the gym.

items.q: Can you install on rocky ground in Ajmer?
items.a: Yes. Rocky ground usually suits grouting, where each post is set in concrete. We confirm the method for each machine after seeing photos of your site.

items.q: How long does the warranty last on the frames?
items.a: Three years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts, and 1 year on springs and bearings. It covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.
